text:
Ana (sales): Hey team — Sentri (enterprise POC) asks for a temporary hosted QPS increase for a demo run next Tue 09:00-12:00 PT. They expect a sustained ~60 rps with bursts to 120 rps. Can we provision a scoped key and a soft quota bump?
Mike R (SRE): We can do a scoped key + ephemeral token. Need exact token TTL and the intended region. Also, what model and avg tokens/resp?
Ana (sales): Region: us-west-2. Model: rdx-medium-L, avg response ~350 tokens, ~2 requests/sec per user. TTL desired: 6 hours including buffer. Customer will run load window 09:00-12:00 and a warmup 08:45-09:00.
Raj (eng): For that pattern, 60 rps at 350 tokens ~= 21k tokens/sec -> cost + latency impact. Suggest two safety knobs: prefix KV caching turned on for identical warmup prompts, and fallback policy to rdx-small-L at 200 rps if latency spikes. Also recommend setting a 1s per-client concurrency cap on the client side.
Liz (infra): @Ana can you confirm IPs for allowlist? We'll restrict the scoped key to those CIDRs and the us-west-2 zone. If they want region fallback we can route to eu-west-1 but that needs legal ok.
Ana (sales): Sentri will provide two egress IP ranges by EOD. Legal sign-off already in the SSO doc. Security flagged data retention question — they want logs disabled for those keys.
Mike R (SRE): We can set the scoped key to opt-out of debug logs, but audit events (request ids, timestamps) are kept for 30d by default. For additional retention controls we'd need an enterprise Private setup.
POC-bot: ephemeral key created: scope=hosted.read-write, region=us-west-2, ttl=6h, id=ephemeral-2131234567 (DO NOT SHARE).
Raj (eng): Quick config snippet for canary fallback policy if capacity degraded:
```
fallbacks:
  - model: rdx-small-L
    trigger: latency_p95 > 1200ms for 2m
    max_qps: 200
```
Mike R (SRE): Approved provisional quota: 120 rps burst, 80 rps sustained for 09:00-12:00 PT on 2026-04-14. Conditions: scoped ephemeral key, IP allowlist, no debug log writes, and on-call notified 15m before ramp. I'll add the route in the console.
Ana (sales): Thanks — I'll relay to Sentri and get IPs. Can we also provide a brief cost estimate to share?
Raj (eng): Estimate: ~350 tokens/resp * avg 70 rps * 3h = ~26.5M tokens -> ballpark cost $X (depends on token pricing), plus 20% buffer.
Mike R (SRE): Noted — on-call will monitor. If we see p95 > 1.2s we'll trigger fallback to rdx-small-L.
Ana (sales): Perfect, closing loop. I'll post the IPs once Sentri sends them. :thumbsup:
